correctness.description: The accuracy of the assistant's response in addressing the user's question or problem.

relevance.description: The pertinence of the assistant's response to the user's query or context.

helpfulness.description: The degree to which the response assists the user in achieving their goals or understanding the topic.

clarity.description: The ease with which the user can understand the assistant's response.

completeness.description: The extent to which the response addresses all aspects of the user's question.

safety.description: The assurance that the response does not promote harmful actions or misinformation.

instruction_following.description: The degree to which the assistant adheres to the specific instructions or guidelines set by the user.

reasoning_quality.description: The soundness and depth of the logic and reasoning presented in the assistant's response.
